reasons.claim: Notification is a regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning), 1.94 ha polygon, status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

One eligible species within 250 m: Goodyera repens (knärot), VU, forest-associated, site-bound vascular plant. Its threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness in tree-covered land. One record from 2025, 197 m away, with 25 m coordinate uncertainty.
Supporting records within 250 m: Camarops tubulina (NT, 2025, 197 m), which is not counted as eligible. Eptesicus nilssonii (NT, mobile, 52 m) is supporting evidence only.

Observation effort is adequate: 103 records within 1000 m against a county median of 66. 16 records fall within 250 m and 0 inside the polygon. The HIGH rating is therefore not an artefact of sparse recording.

uncertainties: The Goodyera repens record is outside the polygon (197 m). Whether the species occurs in the felled stand is unknown.
One record only; its date within 2025 and the exact habitat at its location were not checked.
not_established: That the species occupies the notified polygon.
Anything about the legal status of the felling, since a Red List category is not legal protection.
That the absence of records inside the polygon (0 records) means the polygon holds no species.
next_action: Have an ecologist review the site before felling starts. Check the habitat near the 197 m Goodyera repens record and whether it continues into the polygon. Consider a field survey of the polygon itself.
